verdict.rationale: Loops documents that campaigns, including their content, can be created and managed through the public API and Content API (loops-docs-37, loops-docs-9, loops-docs-26), backed by a published OpenAPI spec (loops-probe-3). However, its own docs say API-created campaigns are drafts that you then "review and send from the dashboard" (loops-docs-5), so the story's core requirement of scheduling and sending without touching the dashboard is not met. Missing for 10: API-based scheduling or sending of campaigns/broadcasts, any documented schedule/send endpoint, independent corroboration of the campaign API.
